Team Codecast

Team Codecast

A team of six from BTech CSE (AIML), Semester 1: Nitish Ruhal, Aarya Goel, Radhika Sharma, Jai Shukla, Leven Soni and Daksh Yadav.

The problem

Engineering students are rarely taught how to write emails, speak up in meetings, present, write reports, make resumes or use LinkedIn, and no single place teaches all six.

Our solution

One web app with seven tabs (Email, Presentation, Meetings, Report, Resume, LinkedIn, Survey) and AI-assisted help for drafting, scoring and speaking.

7-day journey

Day 1 Problem identified, Day 2 Solution planned, Day 3 Toolkit built, Day 4 Survey, Day 5 Feedback analysed, Day 6 Design and AI polish, Day 7 Final presentation.
